rollups.text: Modern Art Gallery and Abstract Expressionism: attended a guided tour about Abstract Expressionism at the Modern Art Gallery on 2023-02-17 and described it as amazing and insightful; the guide’s account that Jackson Pollock was inspired by Navajo sand paintings fascinated the user. On 2023-05-20, the user planned to visit the gallery again and expressed fascination with Jackson Pollock and Mark Rothko, especially their techniques, creative processes, inspirations, and influence on later art movements.

They use EcoClean dish soap, are open to alternatives, and were interested in refill and subscription options for household products. The user made turkey spaghetti Bolognese at home for the first time during the week before 2023-05-25 and said it turned out amazing. They planned mushroom-and-spinach cream pasta with cherry tomatoes, and sought advice about fresh spinach and mushrooms. They were interested in Korean-style fried chicken, chose coarse gochugaru for intense heat and flavor, and planned a gochujang marinade for grilled chicken. They also planned a vegetable frittata using roasted sweet potato and caramelized onions, and experimented with chicken marinades. They make chicken fajitas and wanted to save and repurpose leftovers; the last serving of one batch, with sautéed onions and bell peppers, was eaten on 2023-05-27 and was the third meal from that batch. They prefer flour tortillas for fajitas.

The user prefers a small, intimate bridal shower with close friends and family and chose a romantic, whimsical garden-party theme over brunch and bubbly; they planned a DIY craft station with varied options, especially a wish tree, and intended to display examples and provide materials.

Kadence book/profile project: on 2023-05-23, the user was developing “The Journey,” beginning with a section titled “Who is Kadence.” The supplied biography presents Kadence as a 25-year-old musician from New York City who was raised in Jamaica, discovered rap and hip-hop there, began performing as Kadence in 2012, became known in Mandeville, and moved to Toronto in 2015. The user described the work as an evolving behind-the-scenes framework for future Kadence-specific content, not as a finished account. They want cinematic, autobiographical storytelling that draws on life experiences, can leave blanks for later personal stories, and introduces the next stage of a hero’s journey. The assistant suggested “The Origin of Kadence’s Passion for Music” as the next chapter. The user hopes the story will inspire and move readers and make them want to continue.
entities: The Origin of Kadence’s Passion for Music
